title: Hlaf were nice, half I didn't like
text:
Hlaf were nice, half I didn't like. I was mixed on this. I liked the two dark green ones a lot. Those looked pretty, and I am going to keep those. I put them up.

The other two just didn't look good to me. They seemed faded and very unrealistic. I just didn't think they were attractive.

Overall, the qaulity was okay. You can put them all together or seperately. I do like fake plants overall since they stay the same and you don't have to worry about them.
